title: Still no results for Buenos Aires or the 14 Nov One Piece regionals
detail: Limitless Pokémon lists nothing newer than Gdańsk (31 Oct); its One Piece list still ends 26 Jul. Winners stay unconfirmed. Next: Pokémon Latin America Internationals, São Paulo, 20–22 Nov.

title: OP-18 dates: sources still disagree
detail: Bandai's English event page runs OP-18 release events from 20 Nov. A retailer blog (Samurai Sword Tokyo) still quotes 22 Nov (official X) vs 28 Nov (Japanese retailers). Treat 20 Nov EN / 21 Nov JP as likely, not confirmed. French date unconfirmed.
source: Bandai EN event page; Samurai Sword Tokyo (secondary)

title: Réunion: Miyata Kard Market restock due tomorrow (17 Nov)
detail: Delta Reign page still says 'Arrivage prévu le 17/11/2026': Tripack €19.99, Elite Trainer Box €79.99, 6-booster Bundle €44.99, display €239.99, single booster €7.99. Stock labels on the page conflict (add-to-cart and 'Épuisé' together), so check each product page.

title: Price check: still no 20% moves
detail: TCGdex Cardmarket 7-day vs 30-day averages: Mew ex 152 €81.34 vs €86.68 (−6%); Gengar ex 154 €61.78 vs €65.38 (−6%); Pikachu ex 150 €50.22 vs €52.44 (−4%). Other cards not checked (API was unavailable at first). Nothing to act on.
